title: Police Step in When Creep Won’t Leave Ex Alone
description:
This police officer just broke into his ex-girlfriend's house while she was having sex with her boyfriend. It even left the two female officers in shock when they learned how the suspect officer managed to discover his ex’s boyfriend’s full name. Mr. Security's insecurity was oozing all over this case. Even after what the man had done to her, the woman was very concerned about him. He’s so gonna regret his actions after watching this video. The police were going to find very interesting footage in the morning when the neighborhood surveillance was checked. Police found footage of the officer in question parking his marked vehicle near his ex’s house, then running her boyfriend’s license plate to obtain his information, and finally breaking into the house. This was enough evidence to put him in cuffs. The man was immediately arrested after his fingerprints were confirmed, but this was just the beginning of the story. He was placed on administrative leave without pay, pending a pre-determination hearing regarding his employment with MSCO. He was later re-arrested on four felony counts of unauthorized computer use after investigators confirmed that he had illegally accessed the law enforcement database. His mother was unhappy about the police arresting him. The man was charged with Burglary Of Occupied Dwelling Unarmed W/o Assault Or Battery Charge and Criminal Mischief 200 Dollars And Under.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
